title: Erratum record (registry/errata/<configuration>/ERR-NNN.yaml)
description: The effect of one defect on one registered configuration (a SoC release or a silicon revision): forms present, exposure and how it was established, category, conditions, workaround, status and errata-document revision. Owner: registry loader. F1, F2, F3, F4.

id.description: The configuration's errata_prefix, then -ERR-NNN (README section 3 rule 11).

configuration.description: F1: exactly one configuration from registry/eligibility.yaml.

forms_present.description: F1: ids of the defect's forms present in this configuration.

exposure.description: F2: how exposure was established. Only a detector run on the configuration's built output (generated RTL or netlist) can prove `exposed`, `affected` or `not-affected`, and it must carry the structured `run`. Ancestry or reading the source gives at most `probably-exposed` (amber) or `probably-not-affected` (ancestry says the fix is in).

detector.description: Id of the detector in the defect record (README section 3 rule 4).

evidence.description: What was checked, where, and the result, in one line. For a detector: the input (archive, netlist) and its md5. Commit ids in this text must also appear in the record's `cites` (rule 9).

category.description: F1: A, B or C (Arm SDEN style); null while undecided.

conditions.description: F1: what must hold in this configuration for the defect to bite.

merged.description: Reachable from the component's default branch when last checked.

cites.description: F3: every commit this record's free text (evidence, conditions, workaround rules) names, as structured citations, so T0's refs-resolve gate can prove each exists on its canonical host. The loader refuses a 7 to 40 hex token in free text that no structured citation of the record matches (README section 3 rule 9).

status.description: F1. `permanent` is for silicon configurations only, and a silicon configuration's erratum is never `fixed` (loader rules 6 and 10).

doc_revision.description: F1, F4: the revision of this configuration's errata document in which this record last changed.

detector_run.description: F2 (interfaces.md section 6a): one run of a defect's detector on one configuration's built output, as `nanosoc-rm detect` prints it. A person or a CI job runs it; the service never does (A4).

forms.description: The forms the detector reported. Empty when clean.

detector_source.description: The detector's code, pinned by commit; null for a pattern detector, which lives in the defect record.
